name: Minto ReferralCrowdsale unchecked payment token
summary: Minto's ReferralCrowdsale.buyTokens() checked the payment token against its whitelist only on the DEX/CEX purchase path; while a manual price was set it went straight to _buy(), which sends BTCMT first and then pulls payment from the caller-supplied token. The attacker passed its own contract, whose transferFrom just returns true, as payment for 12,100 USDT worth and received 14,724 BTCMT, which it sold for 9,646 USDT.
notes: Reset: the crowdsale proxy's creation, which installed implementation 0x0d116ed4 and has not been upgraded; dexInfo.manualPrice was nonzero from initialisation, and changePrices() only moved its value (e.g. 0x3ffb885e).

The queue draft's signature-replay description is wrong: no signature is checked on this path (linkSignature and buySignature are empty). BTCMT is valued at DefiLlama's price; the attacker's sale realised 9,646.45 USDT.
